Internal helper: mark a chart as jplot()'s, with the frame's facts

Source: R/plot.R
dot-jst_plot_finish.Rd

The class "jst_plot" ahead of ggplot2's, so the chart is still a ggplot (p + ggplot2::theme() works) and jtable() knows it from a chart drawn by hand (the S412 audit's F6, Session 413), and an attribute with what a figure frame needs: the kind of chart, its N (the cases it draws; the S412 audit's F7), its default title (ruling R69), its data for the Excel sheet (ruling R65), the variables it names by name or by code where no label stood (ruling R72), the scales that carry its colors and the look it was drawn in.

Usage

.jst_plot_finish(
  p,
  kind,
  n = NA_integer_,
  title = NA_character_,
  data = NULL,
  names_shown = character(0),
  codes_shown = list(),
  scales = list(),
  labelled = FALSE,
  look = NULL,
  tweak = NULL,
  filter = NULL,
  data_name = NULL,
  rerun = "chart",
  code_labels = list()
)

Arguments

p

The ggplot.

kind

Character(1).

n

The N, or NA.

title

Character(1), the default title (labels, never the chart's kind), or NA.

data

A data frame of what the chart shows, or NULL.

names_shown

Character; variables the chart names by name, having no label.

codes_shown

A named list: by variable, the codes shown with no label.

scales

A list of list(aes, levels, guide): the color scales.

labelled

Logical(1); TRUE when any variable the chart shows carries a label.

look

The look it was drawn in.

tweak

NULL, or a theme setting of the chart's own (the heatmap's slanted axis text), added again when the chart is drawn in another look.

filter

NULL, or the filters it was drawn under (.jst_plot_filter_facts()), for the figure's note.

data_name

The data frame's name as typed, or NULL: the frame ruling R72's note names in its jrelabel() line.

rerun

What ruling R72's note asks for once labels are added: "chart" (draw it again) or "analysis" (run the analysis and draw it).

code_labels

By variable of codes_shown, the codes it does label (code = label), for the note's jrelabel() line.

Value

The chart.
